caption: A small red sailboat with an ivory sail drifts slowly to the right across a calm alpine lake. Gentle ripples spread behind the hull and the sail moves lightly in the breeze. Forested slopes and distant mountains remain in the background under warm morning sunlight. The camera stays still.

An orange tabby cat sits on a wooden windowsill in warm morning light. It slowly turns its head toward the garden, blinks, and makes a small ear movement while its body remains seated. Leaves outside the window sway gently. The camera stays still.
